evidence: Recomputed across all 48 pairs: mean optimal lag = +6.21s, median = +7.0s, mode = +7.0s (13 pairs). 40 of 48 pairs fall in [+4s, +10s].
scientific_risk: Using raw monitor HR array directly as supervised training labels would misalign target labels by 6 to 7 seconds (more than half of a 10s window).
recommended_action: Disqualify monitor HR array; generate all window training targets strictly from ecg_lead2 R-peaks.

evidence: MAT headers lack hardware clock, PPS pulse, or common digitizer timestamp. Status labeled UNVERIFIED_TIMING for hardware clock.
scientific_risk: Sub-second physical synchronization cannot be verified at hardware clock level; millisecond-level modeling (e.g. PTT) is unfeasible.
recommended_action: Formally decouple status columns: retain UNVERIFIED_HARDWARE_CLOCK; rely on window-level temporal adequacy for 10s windows.

evidence: Report stated surrogate correlation 'never exceeded 0.42' and 'reduced to 0.34'. CSV proves values reach 0.8123 (mean 0.5077, Resting mean 0.6289).
scientific_risk: Overstates false-positive suppression and statistical significance of empirical respiratory cross-correlation peaks.
recommended_action: Correct report narrative to cite true empirical surrogate range (0.16 to 0.81); avoid unsubstantiated claims of universal suppression.

evidence: Report claimed surrogate significance at 'p < 0.001'. Minimum achievable empirical p-value from N=5 surrogate draws is 1/(5+1) ~ 0.167.
scientific_risk: Invalid statistical inference and false precision in formal scientific report.
recommended_action: Remove p < 0.001 claim; specify that p < 0.001 under strict inequality requires N >= 1000 surrogate trials.

evidence: Report stated negative-polarity Resting pairs were VS02 and VS19. CSV proves negative-polarity pairs are actually VS09 and VS20 (VS02 and VS19 have +1).
scientific_risk: Misidentifies subject recordings exhibiting inverted displacement conventions.
recommended_action: Correct subject IDs in report text to VS09_Resting and VS20_Resting.

evidence: Report stated 14 of 24 Resting subjects exceeded 0.85 correlation. CSV proves exactly 6 exceeded 0.85 (VS03, 07, 10, 12, 17, 24); 16 exceeded 0.70.
scientific_risk: Inaccurate summary reporting of empirical correlation distribution.
recommended_action: Correct text to state that 6 subjects exceeded 0.85 and 16 exceeded 0.70.

evidence: Rule best_lag_s >= 4 lumps lags < 4s into NEAR_ZERO_LATENCY, assigning it to -3s (VS05_Apnea) and +3s (VS13_Apnea) with contradictory reason 'curve flatness' when is_ambiguous was False. categorize_monitor_latency is wired at runner.py:164; the v2 results reflect it in outputs/closure/v2/ but outputs/phase2a/ is not regenerated.
scientific_risk: Scientifically invalid labeling of large 3-second shifts as 'near zero' and internal logic contradiction in reason string.
recommended_action: Refactor status logic in a future step to separate negative lags from near-zero lags (|tau| <= 1s) and fix reason string conditional assignment.

evidence: Rule requires only len(valid_rr) >= 5 beats in 120 seconds to award PASS verdict. compute_ecg_sqi runs inside detect_r_peaks and its verdict is not exported; amplitude stability UNSPECIFIED / NOT VALIDATED.
scientific_risk: Highly noisy or corrupted ECG segments with only 5 detectable beats could be falsely labeled as valid ground truth.
recommended_action: Implement multi-parameter Signal Quality Index (SQI) evaluating beat coverage (> 85%), maximum gap (< 3s), and amplitude stability in a future approved step.

evidence: 10-second window yields native frequency resolution of 0.1 Hz = 6.0 bpm; estimator has no parabolic interpolation or zero-padding. estimate_peak_frequency_parabolic is wired inside compute_window_level_hr_agreement; the multi-estimator outputs are not exported; outputs/phase2a/ is not regenerated.
scientific_risk: Discretization noise inflates MAE and creates ladder-step HR predictions.
recommended_action: Implement 3-point parabolic peak interpolation or zero-padding (e.g. 4x) to refine spectral peak frequencies in a future approved step.

evidence: Trial shifts in [-5, +5]s were optimized and evaluated on the same 23 windows; diagnostic split proves chosen lag fails to generalize on held-out windows. estimate_window_hr_multi_estimator is wired inside compute_window_level_hr_agreement; the multi-estimator outputs are not exported; outputs/phase2a/ is not regenerated.
scientific_risk: Best-shift error overstates actual window-level timing precision due to in-sample selection optimism.
recommended_action: Use prespecified zero-shift baseline without best-shift optimization (2.97 bpm Resting MAE) for window-level evaluation, noting it remains subject to ECG-label limits.

evidence: During voluntary apnea, breathing is suppressed; cross-correlating flatline or low-amplitude baseline drift produces arbitrary peaks (mean corr 0.41).
scientific_risk: Misinterprets baseline noise cross-correlation as respiratory synchronization during apnea.
recommended_action: Mark all Apnea respiratory cross-correlations as INCONCLUSIVE (suppressed breathing); rely strictly on cardiac BCG agreement for Apnea.

evidence: File is uncompressed 1.4 MB, contains double-precision floats, 0 NaNs, and 30,600 respiration samples (vs integer ADC counts, compressed ~230 KB, ~120 NaNs, and 30,720 samples in all other 47 files). truncate_respiration_dynamic_length_in_memory is TEST_ONLY; the pipeline already truncates to the minimum length after resampling (runner.py:128 via resample_signals_to_2000hz); the tail-truncation assumption is NOT_VERIFIABLE (see ISS-22).
scientific_risk: Potential array mismatch if full 120s (30,720 samples) is assumed without checking sample counts; cause of formatting difference is NOT_VERIFIABLE.
recommended_action: Ensure all preprocessing pipelines dynamically query array length and truncate trailing tail safely in-memory; do not infer unverified post-collection processing causes.

evidence: Phase 1 reported 0 NaNs in reference data by inspecting only the 120-point HR array (uint8), while Step 2B identified 119 to 120 periodic delimiter NaNs in 47 of 48 ecg_lead2 arrays (float64).
scientific_risk: Users may falsely assume the continuous ECG waveform is completely free of missing samples or reject Step 2B findings as contradictory.
recommended_action: Document that Phase 1 audited the uint8 HR array while Step 2B audited the float64 ecg_lead2 waveform; mandate in-memory single-sample interpolation of delimiter NaNs for ECG processing.

evidence: TechValidation.m is cited in dataset README and Phase 1/2A summaries but is completely absent from the local workspace and dataset directory.
scientific_risk: Claims attributing pipeline design or threshold validation to TechValidation.m cannot be verified or reproduced locally.
recommended_action: Record TechValidation.m status as NOT_AVAILABLE — EXCLUDED FROM SCOPE; mark all claims citing its execution as UNVERIFIED.

evidence: Unit test assertion threshold was loosened from r < 0.30 to r < 0.75 and test fixture modified with broadband noise and AM modulation after circular-shift test failed on harmonic periodicity.
scientific_risk: Threshold loosening weakens unit test discriminative power; a bound of 0.75 passes high surrogate coherence, so the test barely discriminates.
recommended_action: Preserve test for current execution pass; replace in a later approved step with a prespecified justified assertion (e.g. real correlation exceeding a high percentile of surrogate distribution on synthetic signal).

evidence: Headline claimed 'WINDOW-LEVEL ALIGNMENT ADEQUATE FOR 10 s WINDOWS' before defining prespecified adequacy criteria or verifying test-set generalization.
scientific_risk: Prematurely endorses window-level alignment as adequately validated, risking unverified supervised training.
recommended_action: Mark headline NOT YET SUPPORTED; replace with conservative evidence-matched headline; require recording-level SQI (>85% coverage) and window-level coverage (>80%) gates before label generation approval.

evidence: Surrogate test uses only N=5 surrogate realizations, yielding minimum possible empirical p-value of 1/(5+1) ~ 0.167; surrogate mean correlation (0.6289 Resting, 0.3865 Apnea) is very close to real correlation (0.7005 Resting, 0.4130 Apnea).
scientific_risk: Small sample size cannot establish statistical significance under alpha=0.05, and surrogate barely suppresses low-frequency coherence; prior claim of p < 0.001 is mathematically false.
recommended_action: Maintain respiratory alignment status as CONSISTENT_NOT_PROVEN until a formal N >= 1000 surrogate run is approved and executed.

evidence: Thresholds for respiratory correlation (r >= 0.40) and cardiac window agreement (MAE < 5.0 bpm) were implemented in runner.py without prespecified protocol or validated justification.
scientific_risk: Thresholds are not prespecified in any available document; provenance NOT_VERIFIABLE; risk confirmation bias and lack independent prior justification.
recommended_action: Formally label the 5.0 bpm and 0.40 correlation thresholds as UNVERIFIED_PROVENANCE in audit documentation until an independent validated reference is provided.

evidence: Prior draft claimed linear interpolation introduces 'zero discernible distortion to QRS complexes' and VS24_Resting 'strongly suggests post-collection processing by authors' without measured verification.
scientific_risk: Unqualified claims overstate certainty regarding signal distortion and unverified external processing causes.
recommended_action: Qualify statements: mark interpolation distortion UNVERIFIED pending quantitative check; state VS24 formatting differences strictly as observations with cause NOT_VERIFIABLE.

evidence: Discrepancies of 0.02 to 0.08 bpm in monitor HR MAE (2.51 vs 2.5586; 1.82 vs 1.9029) and window MAE (2.94 vs 2.9652; 3.82 vs 3.7961) were labeled 'minor rounding / VERIFIED'.
scientific_risk: Inconsistent application of numerical tolerance obscures genuine averaging differences between report narrative and CSV data.
recommended_action: Apply uniform 0.0100 bpm tolerance: mark all exceedances as DISCREPANCY in claim table and reconcile with exact CSV averages.

evidence: Single-sample delimiter NaN interpolation guard (formerly tracked as ISS-13b; only isolated NaNs interpolated, max_gap=1; multi-sample gaps un-interpolated); verified across all 48 Mindray files (5,629 isolated NaNs, 0 multi-sample gaps, 1 edge NaN at index 0 of VS10_Resting filled by nearest value). clean_ecg_isolated_nans is wired through clean_ecg_nans; outputs/phase2a/ is not regenerated.
scientific_risk: Multi-sample NaN interpolation could distort QRS complexes and generate spurious R-peaks.
recommended_action: Restrict in-memory linear interpolation strictly to isolated single-sample NaNs; reject and flag multi-sample gaps without corrupting QRS complexes.

evidence: VS24_Resting respiration is 30,600 samples; truncation assumes the missing samples are at the tail, which is NOT_VERIFIABLE; the file has a different format. Code available in truncate_respiration_dynamic_length_in_memory; not wired into the pipeline / pipeline results not regenerated
scientific_risk: Assuming tail truncation without hardware timing verification risks arbitrary temporal alignment if missing samples occurred at lead-in or mid-recording.
recommended_action: Sensitivity analysis with and without VS24_Resting in a later approved step.

evidence: cardiac_surrogate_mae (src/sync_validation/cardiac_radar_validator.py:267) is non-deterministic between runs due to unseeded np.random.permutation (verified: differs on repeated in-memory runs across recordings). In contrast, compute_surrogate_respiratory_control (src/sync_validation/respiratory_validator.py:225) is fully deterministic (uses np.random.default_rng(42); verified identical on repeated runs); its divergence from outputs/phase2a arises from a historical method change from circular shifts to Fourier phase randomization (N=5) documented in Section 21.6.
scientific_risk: Non-reproducible surrogate metrics prevent exact regression verification and obscure whether statistical null thresholds are consistently satisfied.
recommended_action: Replace unseeded np.random.permutation in cardiac_surrogate_mae with a seeded generator (e.g. np.random.default_rng(seed)) to ensure run-to-run determinism; record and fix all PRNG seeds in the future prespecified N >= 1000 surrogate protocol.

evidence: Phase 3 ecg_reference.py:102,116 rejects any recording with a boundary NaN (VS10_Resting, 22 windows), while the Stage 2 cleaning handles it (156 beats, tested in K1).
scientific_risk: Rejection of viable recordings due to boundary NaNs artificially reduces training dataset size and creates discrepancy with sync_validation.
recommended_action: Adopt Stage 2 clean_ecg_nans boundary handling across Phase 3 upon investigator approval.

evidence: Phase 3 integer-hop accumulation start += 1667 drops the 23rd window (7 samples short); time-based starts give 23 (J3).
scientific_risk: Discretization drift excludes 48 viable 10-second windows (4.98 seconds per recording) from supervised dataset.
recommended_action: Replace integer-hop accumulation with round-based time formula start_k = int(round(k * 5.0 * fs)) pending PI decision D1.

evidence: two ECG label pipelines with different detector, RR range and coverage threshold (per S1 numbers).
scientific_risk: Discrepant peak detection logic (e.g. VS19 polarity difference) and aggregation definitions produce inconsistent ground-truth HR targets.
recommended_action: Harmonize on a single canonical ECG detector and window aggregation definition pending PI decision D7.

evidence: run_001 label manifests exist, generated 2026-10-15 before the gate decision, status UNAPPROVED, SUPERSEDED (see run_001_status_note.md).
scientific_risk: Premature use of unapproved, superseded manifests would violate gate governance and propagate pre-Stage-2 discrepancies.
recommended_action: Retain run_001 manifests as read-only diagnostic records; require explicit PI sign-off on decision D3 before regenerating.

evidence: respiratory cross-correlation lag is method-sensitive; plateau width median 95 ms (34.5 ms to 1,594 ms) in K3; the DC-product hypothesis was not supported (rho = -0.1254, p = 0.3956); mechanism NOT_ESTABLISHED.
scientific_risk: Over-interpreting discrete lag peaks risks unverified claims of physical hardware synchronization.
recommended_action: Document lag plateau width and classify hardware timing as UNVERIFIED_HARDWARE_TIMING_NOMINAL_T0 per PI decision D4 and D5.
